Rule.name: LDAP ApacheDS - Disable Terminated Users
Rule.Description:
Catch-up rule: disables the LDAP ApacheDS account of every identity whose Status is Terminated and whose LDAP account is not disabled yet. Use it for people who became Terminated before the leaver step existed, or after a failure. New leavers are handled by the lifecycle workflow.
Run it from the IIQ console: rule "LDAP ApacheDS - Disable Terminated Users"
